title: Apply for a driver licence without an interlock condition
summary: Learn how to apply for a replacement driver licence after successfully completing the Interlock Program.
intro:
When you've successfully completed your period on the Interlock Program, you'll need to visit a service centre to apply for your replacement licence.

If you were a class C licence holder you'll be issued a replacement class C licence. If you previously held a different class of licence, you may need to take knowledge and driving tests for that licence class, depending on the length of your disqualification.

Take your new licence to an interlock installer, and they'll remove the device from your vehicle.
who_can_apply: You have received a letter advising you have successfully completed the Interlock Program.

how_to_steps.text: Visit a service centre and submit your application with your payment.

more_info.text: For driver licence renewals or applications, a receipt is provided that allows you to drive until the card arrives in the post. The receipt is valid for 2 months.
